Using Git 2.55.0, I pushed into a bare repository with aggressive thresholds using `git -c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false push`. # Implementation Summary (Issue #415)

## What we learned

- Git command-local maintenance flags do not protect local receive-pack; repository-local settings from a suite-owned template survive credential filtering and protect bare receivers.
- Private CLI repositories alone do not establish parallel eligibility: storage maintenance uses the process cache, and cancellation-sensitive diagnostics must also be audited.

## Working Tree Changes

## Developer report

# ISSUE-415 implementation evidence

Status: maintenance prerequisite implemented; stabilized baseline measurement in progress. Acceptance is not yet established.

Read SYSTEM_PROMPT.md, WORKUNIT.md, PLAN.md, TEST_PLAN.md, REVIEW.md and the swarm-implement command instructions before edits. This is a source snapshot with an empty .git; source hashes identify phases instead of a Git revision. Go 1.27.1, Git 2.55.0, Linux amd64. All measured Go commands use GOMAXPROCS=4 GOFLAGS=-p=2. Raw evidence, original source copies, hashes and command records live under `$TMPDIR/issue415/`; scratch output is outside the workspace. Prior 3/3 baseline failures are attributed historical evidence; prior logs are unavailable in this fresh sandbox, and those failed timings cannot be denominators.

## Stabilization decision

Use the plan's permitted simpler equivalent: TestMain publishes a suite-owned Git template containing gc.auto=0, maintenance.auto=false, gc.autoDetach=false before tests run. Git copies it into repository-local config during init/clone, before commits and receiving work. Linked worktrees read their common repository config. This covers the audited fixture helpers, upstream/fork/continuation/revocation bare repositories and raw storage exec.Command paths without per-command filesystem writes or changes to production/shared Git helpers. Both gitfixture and gitcredential preserve GIT_TEMPLATE_DIR; neither requires weakening its configuration/credential filtering. Searches found no --template override or explicit replacement environment for repository creation. The one existing custom-template test remains serial and creates no repositories while its override is installed.

Only the exact suite-owned immutable template is normalized by fixture cache eligibility; custom templates still force fallback. Existing cache keys, allocation padding, admission and scheduling remain unchanged. The lifetime/isolation regression now mutates consumer maintenance config concurrently, verifies distinct template/consumer inodes, confirms seed and template unchanged, and checks a later copy retains policy. No new committed seed inputs or mutable state sharing.

Added TestCLIGitMaintenancePolicy checks repository-local values for standard fixtures, bare origins, raw Git init under aggressive command-local configuration, and a CLI-created linked worktree. TestCLIGitReceiveCloneCleanup performs a local push with low maintenance thresholds, requires Trace2 start events from receiving execution, rejects maintenance/gc/repack child starts, clones the result, checks local config and commit identity, and synchronously removes the fixture without suppressing cleanup errors.

## Focused evidence so far

Exact commands and elapsed/exit/source hashes are in the named *.result.json files; command stdout/stderr are adjacent. Original configuration regressions failed (old-regression.log, exit 1, package 0.035s: missing local gc.auto/gc.autoDetach). The first fixed attempt exposed an incorrect regression setup: claim defaulted to unavailable codex; corrected to explicit mock, preserving real CLI claim/worktree creation. fixed-regression-2.log passed (package 0.136s).

- stabilization: go test -count=3 ./internal/cli -run '^(TestForkCLISmoke|TestUpstreamRemoteValidation|TestCLIRevokeForkClaimClearsContributorIndex|TestIssueWorkContinuationCommand)$' passed, wall 21.554s.
- maintenance-final: go test -race -count=1 ./internal/cli -run '^TestCLIGit(MaintenancePolicy|ReceiveCloneCleanup)$' passed, wall 6.383s. Supersedes maintenance-race after strengthening regression assertions.
- fixture-check: go test -count=1 ./internal/cli -run '^(TestCLIFixture.*|TestCLIParallelFixtureIsolation|TestCLIResolverRunnerIsolation)$' passed, wall 1.761s; later changes only strengthen maintenance regression assertions and comments, so fixture source remains applicable.
- fixture-race: same selector with -race passed, wall 8.320s, on baseline source.

## Stable baseline and bounded probe decision

Three consecutive complete full CLI runs passed on byte-identical CLI sources: S1=445.878s, S2=448.417s, S3=440.912s (spread 7.505s). S is the first, 445.878s; the half-time target is 222.939s. No failure occurred in this stabilization sequence. Each run had 422 top-level and 1,328 subtest passes: 420 original top-level passes, 1,328 original subtest passes, and two added top-level regressions. Complete run/pass/fail/skip identity sets match across all three runs (1,753 run identities). Existing skips: TestDelegatedAuthenticatedWorkUnit, TestMixedHarnessAuthenticatedWorkUnit, TestNativeCodexAuthenticatedWorkUnit. All package terminal events are pass, with no cached output. Stable run JSON, result/source-hash files, summaries and comparison.json are the evidence. Scheduling events show peak four active recovery leaves, consistent with unchanged resource admission.

There is no valid passing pre-fix U. Maintenance-only speed-up is unquantifiable; historical failed timings are not compared to S. Original test assertions remain, including cleanup errors, seed fallback/hostile inputs/allocation, and process-default behavior. The strengthened seed regression adds only assertions and a consumer-local configuration mutation.

After the S gate, the reversible probe covered exactly TestIssue322GitHubCommands; TestIssueSubmitAcceptanceEvidenceAdvisory; TestIssueSubmitMappedAcceptanceEvidence; TestPRSubmitAcceptanceEvidenceOutput; TestIssueSubmitMixedAcceptanceEvidence; TestUpstreamPlanReviewCLISeparateCheckout. Audited helper paths included newCLIFixture, submittedPRFixture, prGit, newUpstreamRemoteFixture, its Git/transport/clock and cleanup, and the GitHub test's local transport and coordinator. Each fixture has private roots/tracker/store/claims and injected environment. No Setenv/Chdir or global assignment was found in these paths. Excluded storageScaleHost, bulk cleanup global injection, checkpoint Setenv and recovery parent PATH mutation; retained serial mutation within every fixture. The probe added t.Parallel only at the six parents and independent fixture-creating subcases. Its exact reversible diff is probe.diff.

The focused before selector passed in 33.488s. The after selector FAILED in 17.495s: TestIssue322GitHubCommands/false reported “partial/failed reminder leaked” and “Storage maintenance incomplete ... context canceled” during issue stage plan. This is a failed result, not a speed denominator. Inspection found an overlooked shared input: storage_maintenance.go uses process-wide maintenanceCacheDir/os.UserCacheDir for the maintenance StateRoot, although fixture user/node/registry directories are private. Commands deliberately cancel contexts to test reminder failures; these diagnostics are scheduling-sensitive. The causal path beyond that observation remains unproven; no assertion or storage/credential production behavior was changed to suppress it.

Decision: reject and completely revert the unsafe scheduling probe. Exact restored CLI hashes match every stabilized baseline file. The original GitHub-command selector then passed three repetitions. Scope is reopened under the plan's stop-widening rule: private repositories did not establish full scheduling independence. The measured bounded candidates accounted for only about 34s of the 445.878s baseline, while the matrix already runs private leaves in parallel with nine committed input seeds. No safe winning optimization or distinct C candidate is retained. Do not claim C<=S/2: the retained final source is the maintenance-only S source, and its applicable three passing results are reused; no separate three-run optimized C campaign is represented or manufactured. Steps 5–6's speed-up outcome is unfulfilled. The complete full CLI race run validates the retained prerequisite only. This is a partial implementation needing a reopened optimization plan, not completion of ISSUE-415.

Changed shipped files: internal/cli/fixture_helpers_test.go (template constant/cache guard/additive regressions), internal/cli/native_integration_test.go (pre-test template publication), changes/unreleased/415-git-maintenance.md (one-bullet stability fragment). No scheduling edits remain; all three probe files were restored exactly. Developer artifacts: IMPLEMENTATION.md and LESSONS.md only.
